abstract: Production skill for Z.ai's web search, web reader, and Zread tools. Routes natural-language search requests through MCP on GLM Coding Plan quota by default and the billed REST API only on request, and documents live-measured behaviour from 2026-10-18: ~10 results per search-prime query, ~40 for search_std, rewritten queries, site: as a ranking hint, ignored domain filters, a 1302 throttle at eight concurrent calls, and per-route billing.
